notes: What server-host takes from the room service (realtime-rooms interfaces/room-session.json). The host wraps these exports; it does not replace them.

Room.returns: Durable Object class from createRoomClass; passed through ServerHost.objectClass and bound as ROOM

bindings.ROOM: Durable Object namespace of the Room class (class name Room)
bindings.DIRECTORY: Durable Object namespace of the Directory class (class name Directory)

settings: ServerHost.roomsSettings(applicationId) returns exactly the Settings shape createWorker takes
